complicacoes.texto: When Captain Atom pushes his ability to absorb energy past its normal limits, the accumulated energy “overwash” propels him through time. The exact amount of time traveled is up to the needs of the plot, but a rule of thumb is to take the graduação of the triggering effect and compare it to the Time column of the basic graduação chart – this is how much time is jumped past.
